The '''Flare-P''' was a racing [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] built by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]]. [[Serji-X Arrogantus]] used a Flare-P during his [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] days.
